nodes.description: A patent (US9514753B2) describing methods, systems, and apparatus for performing speaker identification using hash-based indexing of speaker vectors.

A vector derived from an utterance, for which hash values are determined according to multiple different hash functions in order to retrieve candidate speaker vectors.<SEP>A vector derived from an utterance, used as the query representation for identifying a speaker. It may be an i-vector or a vector based on deep neural network activations.

A vector derived from one or more utterances of a respective speaker, used to represent characteristics of that speaker's speech and compared against an utterance vector to identify a speaker.<SEP>A vector derived from one or more utterances of a respective speaker, stored in hash tables and compared against an utterance vector to identify a speaker.
Values determined for an utterance vector or speaker vector according to multiple different hash functions, used to look up speaker vectors in hash tables.
Multiple different functions used to compute hash values for vectors; may include locality sensitive hash functions or functions based on positions of vectors with respect to hyperplanes.
A plurality of tables storing speaker vectors indexed by hash values, from which a set of speaker vectors is determined using the hash values.

A spoken input from which an utterance vector is derived and which is associated with a respective speaker.<SEP>Speech input from which an utterance vector is derived and whose speaker is to be identified.

A person whose speech characteristics are represented by speaker vectors derived from one or more of the speaker's utterances.<SEP>A person whose speech characteristics are represented by speaker vectors and whose identity is determined from the selected speaker vector.

Data indicating the identity of a speaker, determined based on associations between speaker vectors and respective speakers and corresponding to a selected speaker vector.<SEP>The identity of a speaker determined from the selected speaker vector, with data indicating the speaker identity being output.
A vector comprising parameters determined using multivariate factor analysis of an utterance or of one or more utterances of a speaker.
A neural network whose activations, occurring in response to information about an utterance, are used to determine parameters of utterance vectors and speaker vectors.
A type of hash function used to determine hash values for vectors in the speaker identification method.
Geometric constructs with respect to which the position of an utterance vector is used to determine hash values.
Scores that each indicate a degree of similarity between the utterance vector and one of the speaker vectors in the set, used to select the most similar speaker vector.
A measure of distance between the utterance vector and each speaker vector in the set, used to determine similarity scores.
A threshold value against which the smallest cosine distance is compared to decide whether to select the corresponding speaker vector.
Media items that include utterances of a speaker corresponding to the selected speaker vector and that may be identified and output.
A process of authenticating a particular user based at least in part on determining that the selected speaker vector corresponds to that particular user.
A set of multiple video resources that may be accessed to generate a speaker vector for each of the video resources.
A data structure among a plurality of hash tables from which a set of speaker vectors is determined using hash values, where each hash table may yield a different speaker vector.
A value determined for an utterance vector according to a hash function, used to look up speaker vectors in a plurality of hash tables.
One of multiple different hash functions used to determine hash values for an utterance vector.
An utterance vector comprising parameters determined using multivariate factor analysis of the utterance.
A speaker vector comprising parameters determined using multivariate factor analysis of one or more utterances of a respective speaker.
A technique used to determine parameters of utterance i-vectors and speaker i-vectors.
A video resource for which a speaker vector is generated, among a set of multiple video resources accessed.
A device storing instructions that, when executed by one or more computers, cause the computers to perform operations for speaker identification.
One or more computers that execute stored instructions to perform operations such as obtaining utterance vectors, determining hash values, and selecting speaker vectors.
A system comprising one or more computers and a computer-readable storage device storing instructions for performing speaker identification operations.

A network service that enables developers to develop recommenders made available to content site operators for providing recommendations to end users, and that optimizes the use and selection of recommenders for different end users, groups, content sites, and the like.

A site that requests event data storage and item recommendations from the personalization network service and receives selected recommendations to present to end users.<SEP>A site that requests item recommendations from the recommendations system over a computer network via a network service interface, and that may provide recommender selections and weighting selections.

A component developed by developers that generates item recommendations; recommenders may be external and operated by entities different from the personalization network service provider.<SEP>A component or service provided by a recommender provider that uses collected event data regarding user-generated events to select particular items to recommend to users; recommenders are registered with the recommendations system and accessed via network addresses.

A recommender registered with the recommendations service and provided by entities that differ from the provider of the recommendations service, operated by different operators than the personalization network service operator.

An entity that operates and provides recommenders, separate from the operator of the personalization network service.<SEP>An entity, different from the provider of the recommendations system, that provides recommenders and submits registration submissions to request registration of the recommenders with the recommendations system.
A service comprising a recommendations retriever that queries external recommenders, receives recommendations and scores, and selects a subset of recommendations to provide to content sites.
A component of the recommendations service operative to query external recommenders over the computer network for recommendations and receive recommendations and associated scores.
A module configured to normalize associated scores, optimize recommendations based on user-generated events and previous requests, and assign weights to external recommenders.

A module configured to provide functionality for registering an external recommender with the recommendations service.<SEP>A module configured to allow a provider of an external recommender to provide machine readable descriptions of the external recommender.

An interface operative to receive requests from a content site, including requests to store event data and requests for item recommendations, over a computer network.<SEP>An interface over a computer network through which requests from content sites for item recommendations are received.
A repository comprising physical computer storage operative to store event data received from content sites.
An interface operative to provide access to event data to a plurality of external recommenders registered with the recommendations service.
Data descriptive of user-generated events, comprising identifiers of particular items and particular users to which the events correspond.

Events generated by users, including purchase events, item viewing events, and item rating events, used to optimize and adjust recommendations.<SEP>Events generated by users, including purchase events, item viewing events, and item rating events, whose collected event data is used by recommenders to select items to recommend.
Item recommendations generated by recommenders, received with associated scores and selected as a subset to provide to content sites.
Scores associated with recommendations received from recommenders, which are normalized and combined with weights to produce overall scores.

Weights applied to recommenders, which may be site-specific, user-specific, user segment-specific, or default, and are adjusted based on user-generated events.<SEP>Weights applied to each of the recommenders, which may be based on recommender performance and may be selected by content sites.

Scores produced by combining recommendation scores with weights, used to select a subset of recommendations.<SEP>Scores generated by combining the normalized scores with the weights, used in selecting recommendations to provide to content sites.

A system comprising computer hardware programmed to implement the network service interface, event data repository, registration module, data interface, recommendations service, and optimization module.
A network over which requests, recommendations, and scores are transmitted between the content site, personalization network service, and external recommenders.
A patent publication titled "System for obtaining recommendations from multiple recommenders" describing a personalization network service and methods for optimizing recommender results.

A computer-implemented system that registers recommenders from external recommender providers, stores access information for the recommenders, receives requests from content sites for item recommendations, causes the recommenders to provide recommendations, normalizes scores, applies weights, and combines scores to generate overall recommendations.
An operator of a content site who obtains item recommendations for presentation to users and can specify which recommenders are to be used to generate recommendations for the content site.
A person to whom item recommendations are presented by content sites.
A type of user-generated event involving a purchase by a user.
A type of user-generated event involving a user viewing an item.
A type of user-generated event involving a user rating an item.
Submissions received from recommender providers that are operative to request registration of the recommenders with the recommendations system.
Information stored in computer storage for accessing the recommenders with the recommendations system, comprising uniform resource indicators.
The form of access information used for accessing the recommenders with the recommendations system.
Scores produced by normalizing the scores provided by the recommenders.
Sets of recommendations returned by the recommenders that are combined to generate a combined set of recommendations.
A combined set of recommendations generated by combining recommendation sets returned by the recommenders, to be provided to the content site.
A repository that stores information regarding a plurality of recommenders, including network addresses for accessing the recommenders on a network.
A system comprising computer hardware operative to provide a service through which content sites obtain recommendations from the plurality of recommenders for presentation to users.

Performance of each recommender in each of a plurality of contexts, monitored by the server system and used to determine how much weight to give to particular recommenders; comprises user-specific performance, segment-specific performance, and site-specific performance.
A type of context-specific performance relating to a specific user.
A type of context-specific performance relating to a specific segment.
A type of context-specific performance relating to a specific site.
Selections received from content sites indicating which recommenders are to be used.
Selections received from content sites specifying weights to assign to recommenders.
Descriptions of an external recommender that a provider of the external recommender is allowed to provide via the registration module.
